sql: WITH RECURSIVE ages(n) AS(SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT n+10 FROM ages WHERE n<60),u AS(SELECT user_id,birth_date,count(*) copies FROM mst_users GROUP BY user_id,birth_date),boundaries(d) AS(SELECT '2010-01-01' UNION SELECT date(birth_date,'+'||n||' years') FROM u CROSS JOIN ages WHERE date(birth_date,'+'||n||' years') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2040-01-01' UNION SELECT '2040-01-01'),ranges AS(SELECT d,lead(d) over(order by d) next_d FROM boundaries),a AS(SELECT d,next_d,u.*,cast(substr(d,1,4) as int)-cast(substr(birth_date,1,4) as int)-(substr(d,6)<substr(birth_date,6)) age FROM ranges CROSS JOIN u) SELECT d,date(next_d,'-1 day') through,sum(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN copies ELSE 0 END) c20,sum(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN copies ELSE 0 END) c30,sum(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN copies ELSE 0 END) c40,sum(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN copies ELSE 0 END) c50,sum(CASE WHEN age<20 OR age>=60 THEN copies ELSE 0 END) others FROM a WHERE next_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d,next_d ORDER BY d
